name: When should I re-stain or re-seal my log home?

mainEntity.name: When should I re-stain or re-seal my log home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The need to re-stain or re-seal depends on the type of finish, exposure to elements, and the condition of the existing coating. Generally, most log homes require re-staining or re-sealing every 3-7 years. Look for signs like fading, cracking, peeling, or water not beading on the surface as indicators.
acceptedAnswer.description: Re-stain or re-seal your log home every 3-7 years, or when the finish shows signs of wear.
